inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The play structure on the playground for younger children had less than 6 inches of loosefill and only had two and a half inches of mulch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One out of 10 children's files did not have an up-to-date immunization record available to review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There were broken toys/items and trash scattered all over the big back playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Plan for extreme weather conditions: The operational policy did not specify how to provide indoor physical activity during extreme weather.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Plan for extreme weather conditions (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(G))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguishers were last serviced in October 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The side back door on the big playground was not latched correctly. Allowing children to have unrestricted access.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was determined that proper supervision was not being practiced when caregivers were leaving the school-age group unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A person was observed coming out of a classroom that had children and they did not have a cleared background check.     Corrected at inspection: The person left during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions: An infant was observed in a bouncy seat and was sitting straight up, as not permitted by the manufacturer's instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Used According to Manufacturer's Instructions (26 TAC §746.4601(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was observed that the Pre-K classroom door that leads to the playground was propped open with a chair while the children were playing outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the DFPS investigation, a caregiver left the classroom door open, which allowed a child to walk out of the classroom and leave the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the DFPS investigation, a two-year-old child walked out of the operation unsupervised and was found walking down the road.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: There was one caregiver in charge of a classroom with 10 children who ranged in age. The classroom was out of ratio by 5 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: It was observed during the investigation of the Pre-K classroom needing repairs due to water damage.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two of ten children's records reviewed did not have a statement of the child's health from a health-care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The school aged playground had a broken plastic barrier, creating a sharp point on the play equipment.  The playground also had tree limbs and broken play equipment in the play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: On 11/14/24, the director was caring for 23 children with a specified age group of 4 years, placing the classroom over ratio by five children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Routines maintained: Child was sent home with feces in pants. Child was not asked if they needed to go to the restroom or checked by caregiver to see if they were clean prior to being sent home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Routines maintained (26 TAC §746.2601(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A staff member who had direct access to children in care did not have an eligible background check on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One of seven employee records reviewed did not have the required 24 hour of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One of six caregiver's records reviewed was missing training for the previous training year in the required topics of: 1) Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations 2) Administering medication 3) Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction 4) Understanding building and physical premises safety and 5) Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Child Becomes Ill in Care - Contact Parent: Parent was not notified when caregiver found blisters on a child's buttocks when being provided a diaper change in the morning. The child was later diagnosed to have Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Becomes Ill in Care - Contact Parent (26 TAC §746.3605(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two out of seven caregivers did not have the required 24 hour  clock trainings. One staff was missing eighteen hours and the other fifteen.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: There was a fire extinguisher on top of the shelf that was not mounted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §746.5305)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: The infant caregiver did not have the current SID's and Shaken Baby Syndrome traninings renewed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The operations Emergency Preparedness Plan was missing specific procedures for evacuating and relocating children who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency, such as children who have mental, visual, or hearing impairments.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 out of the 10 children's records reviewed were missing current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A five month old infant was sleeping on a bouncy  device in the infant room. The infant was covered  with a blue blanket.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: A five month old infant was sleeping on a bouncy covered with a blue fleece blanket. The infant was not placed in their crib because he looked comfortable.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427)

occurrences.finding: Director Certificate Not Renewed: The operation director has not obtained their director's renewal permit since January 16,2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Certificate Not Renewed (26 TAC §746.1057)

occurrences.finding: Director Certificate Not Renewed: The operation director has not obtained their director's renewal permit since January 16,2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Certificate Not Renewed (26 TAC §746.1057)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings: The pre-school/school age play structure had two detected barriers from the supporting beam on the play equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(3))

occurrences.finding: Definition- What does Licensing mean by the term ?use zone??: There were two play toys in front of the toddler play structure slide.       Note. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Definition- What does Licensing mean by the term ?use zone?? (26 TAC §746.4801)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two outdoor toys were found broken in the pre-school playground. A push car and a child size patio plastic chair.    Note. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits: The exit pathway for the children in the 2 and 3 year old classroom did not have a clear path. There were trash bags, sleeping mats, unrolled hose, electrical box, and mop buckets in the walk way.      Note. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Blocked or Locked Doors as Exits (26 TAC §746.5209(c))
